Subject: SOW sequencing and rate transfer request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement at Helios ran the numbers overnight and we need to ask for two small but important changes before we can proceed to signature:

1) Split the implementation SOW into Phase A (pilot, 2 months) + Phase B (scale, 10 months) with separate acceptance windows so we can reduce risk during the pilot.
2) Transfer a portion of the monthly throughput rate from the base order form to an add-on SKU (so we can move budget between cost centers).

Both changes are commercial-only; we do not expect to change service levels. Could you provide a redlined SOW and an updated order form reflecting the rate transfer by EOD Monday? Procurement would like to avoid a prolonged legal loop if possible.

I attached the internal cost breakdown for context (not for external distribution). We are aiming to get internal approvals this week.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik

Helios Systems

Hi Aisha — appreciate the clarity and the numbers.

Attached: Helios_SOW_v3_redline.docx and OrderForm_20260904.xlsx (redlines include the Phase A / Phase B split and a moved SKU for the transferred throughput). Highlights below:

- Implementation sequencing: Phase A (pilot) has a 60-day acceptance window with a clear acceptance criteria checklist (Appx A). Phase B start is contingent on Phase A acceptance or a signed executive waiver.
- Commercial changes: Lifted X% of the base throughput into a new add-on SKU (SKU-BURST-HEL-1). Pricing for SKU-BURST-HEL-1 mirrors the base rate but billed separately to allow cost-center allocation.
- No SLO changes; fallback routing to existing model variants preserved.

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik / Laura: quick legal/commercial sweep on the attached redline (I called out three paragraphs in the SOW that need legal language for the contingency/onboarding waiver).
- Aisha: once we have K/L sign-off, we can prepare a single change order (amendment) and push to DocuSign.

Can you confirm Helios can approve the Phase A acceptance checklist as-is or whether you need edits to Appx A? If you prefer, we can incorporate Helios-approved language into the redline before legal review to shorten the loop.

Thanks,

1) Acceptance checklist: could you add a one-line acceptance tie-breaker if a dispute occurs (we propose escalation to a joint technical review board within 10 business days).
